summary: The upgrade from Ubuntu 20.04 to 22.04 will involve several package updates and some known issues, particularly with cloud-init.

claims.text: The user's installed gcc package will be updated to version 11.2.0.
The init system will be updated to systemd v249.11, which includes the userspace OOMD service.
The upgrade process from Ubuntu 20.04 to 22.04 may encounter known issues, as documented in the release notes.
The upgrade from Ubuntu 21.10 to 22.04 will include all the changes that happened in the six months since Ubuntu 21.10, as well as interim releases.
The upgrade process for Ubuntu Server 22.04 LTS will not support POWER8 systems, as it is compiled for POWER9 processors.
